journeys.name: Location: its manpower, shifts, activities and materials
journeys.objective: Each area to be cleaned is on record with how many people it needs, in which shifts, what is done how often and with what.
journeys.userRole: Housekeeping supervisor (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Housekeeping and clicks Locations in the menu
2. Clicks "New location"
3. Types the code, the name, the service center and 3 as people and clicks "Save"
4. Types the location code, the shift in "Name" and 2 as people, chooses "Save shift" and clicks "Save"; repeats for the second shift with 1
5. Types the location code, the activity in "Name" and daily in "Center / end / frequency", chooses "Save activity" and clicks "Save"
6. Types the location code, the material in "Material" and 2 as quantity, chooses "Save material" and clicks "Save"
7. Types the location code, chooses "Match" and clicks "Save"
8. Looks for the shifts, activities and materials of the location on the screen
journeys.expectedOutcome: A location is complete when its shifts add up to its manpower and it has at least one activity.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/housekeeping/locations opened (HTTP 200, title "Locations"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "New location" on /housekeeping/locations opened the dialog "Locations"; fields: "Location code", "Name", "Center / end / frequency", "Material", "People / quantity", "Action"; buttons: Close, Save. Nothing was saved.
journeys.failureScenarios: Inputs missing; a frequency that is not known; shifts that do not add up (test case below).
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English. In the pass of 2026-10-13 2 of 8 steps were confirmed read-only against the live screen or dialog.
journeys.requiredTestData: Location "X-LT1" "X Lantai 1 uji", service center of the branch, manpower 3; shifts "X Pagi" with 2 people and "X Sore" with 1; activity "X Mengepel" daily; material "X-KARBOL" quantity 2

journeys.name: From the cleaning plan to the bill: one month, end to end
journeys.objective: What was planned for a location, what was logged, and what was billed fit together.
journeys.userRole: Housekeeping supervisor, Accountant (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the housekeeping right. One branch is chosen in the header. The journeys above.
journeys.steps:
1. Sets up a location with shifts that match its manpower, an activity and a material
2. Saves, sends and approves a contract with one price line
3. Saves and approves a log for each shift of each day of the month
4. Saves the bill of the month
5. Compares the bill with the logs and the price line
6. Looks, from a location, for the contract that covers it
